רפד.ja: מעאמלאתה לה וגפלתה ען אדא חק נעמתה עליה, פיתואצ'ע פי נפסה, כמא קאל כי עוני אגיד אדאג מחטאתי.
רפד.en: his ill dealings with Him and his heedlessness of discharging the right of His blessing upon him; let him humble himself within himself, as He said: "For my iniquity I shall declare; I shall be anxious for my sin" (Psalms 38:19).

pairs.en: his ill dealings with Him
let him humble himself within himself
For my iniquity I shall declare

רפד.ja: ואלראבע, אד'א את'ני עליה בסו עמלה, פליתואצ'ע ללה וישכרה אלד'י כשף עליה קלילא מן כת'יר תאדיבא לה ותקריעא ליתוב אליה, כמא קאל ויגל אזנם למוסר ויאמר כי ישובון מאון.
רפד.en: **The fourth**: when he is reproached for his bad work. Let him humble himself before God and thank Him who has uncovered upon him a little of much, by way of disciplining him and reproving him that he may repent — as He said: "And He uncovers their ear to discipline, and says that they should turn from iniquity" (Job 36:10).

pairs.en: **The fourth**
when he is reproached for his bad work
Let him humble himself before God
And He uncovers their ear to discipline

רפד.ja: ואלכ'אמס, אד'א אנעם אללה עליה פי אלדניא בצ'רוב מן אלנעם, פליתואצ'ע ללה לת'קל ט'הרה בחק אלשכר ענהא, ויכ'שע לה כ'ופא מן אן תכון נקמה עליה,
רפד.en: **The fifth**: when God grants him blessing in this world of various kinds of blessings. Let him humble himself before God for the heaviness of his back with the right of thanks for them; let him be lowered before Him out of fear that it should be a vengeance upon him.

pairs.en: **The fifth**

pairs.ja: אד'א אנעם אללה עליה פי אלדניא
pairs.en: when God grants him blessing in this world
Let him humble himself before God

רפד.ja: פאן כת'רהֵ אלמאל פי אלדניא תכון לאחד ת'לאת'ה אשיא, אמא נעמה מן אללה עלי ד'י אלמאל, ואמא מחנה ואכ'תבאר לה, ואמא נקמה ופתנה עליה.
רפד.en: For the abundance of wealth in this world is for one of three things. Either a blessing from God upon the possessor of wealth, or a trial and testing for him, or a vengeance and temptation upon him.

pairs.en: For the abundance of wealth in this world
is for one of three things
Either a blessing from God
or a trial and testing for him
or a vengeance and temptation upon him

רפד.ja: ועלאמהֵ אלנעמה, אן יכון צאחבהא קד שגלה אלקיאם בחקוק אללה ען אלתשאגל בהא, וכאנהֵ סבבא ללאזדיאד מן אלעמל ללה, פלם יחפל באלנעמה ולא תוכל עליהא, וצרפהא פי ואג'באת אללה תעאלי עליה, נט'יר מא וצף איוב ען סירתה פי מאלה ותצריפה לה פי חק אללה, ת'ם קאל פי קלהֵ תוכלה עליה אם שמתי זהב כסלי ולכתם אמרתי מבטחי.
רפד.en: The mark of blessing: the possessor of it is preoccupied with the upholding of the rights of God by it, away from being preoccupied with it. It becomes a cause of his increasing in work for God; he does not crowd around it nor lean upon it, but disburses it in what God (exalted be He) has made obligatory upon him — like Job's description of his way of life with his wealth and his disbursing of it in the right of God; then he said, of the slightness of his reliance upon it: "If I have made gold my confidence, and to the fine gold said, You are my trust" (Job 31:24).

pairs.en: The mark of blessing
preoccupied with the upholding of the rights of God
a cause of his increasing in work for God
If I have made gold my confidence

רפד.ja: ועלאמהֵ אלמחנה ואלאכ'תבאר, אן יכון צאחב אלמאל קד שגל בענאיתה בחפט' אלמאל ואלאזדיאד מנה ואלחד'ר עליה מן אלאפאת ען אלקיאם באלשכר ללה ענה, פצאחבה ממתחן בה, ליס לה מנה אלא טול אלאהתמאם בה ואלקיאם עליה ואלחסאב ענה, ופי מת'לה קאל אלחכים כי כל ימיו מכאובים וכעס ענינו גם בלילה לא שכב לבו.
רפד.en: The mark of trial and testing: the possessor of wealth has been preoccupied with care for keeping the wealth, with increasing it, and with guarding it from misfortunes — away from upholding thanks to God for it. Its possessor is being tested by it; he gets nothing from it but the long preoccupation, the upkeep, and the reckoning concerning it. Of him the Wise One said: "For all his days are pains, and his task is grief; even at night his heart does not rest" (Ecclesiastes 2:23).

pairs.en: The mark of trial and testing
preoccupied with care for keeping the wealth
Its possessor is being tested by it
For all his days are pains
even at night his heart does not rest

רפד.ja: ועלאמהֵ אלנקמה, אן יכון צאחב אלמאל קד שגלה אלתנעם פיה ואלתלד'ד' בה ען אדא חקוק אללה וחקוק
רפד.en: The mark of vengeance: the possessor of wealth has been preoccupied by enjoyment of it and pleasure in it from discharging the rights of God and the rights of

pairs.en: The mark of vengeance
preoccupied by enjoyment of it and pleasure in it
